notes: Exa API key lives on the instance account 6a8d88635be7850c2bdfd5fd; the local CLI configstore has no Exa entry, so verification was driven through the instance (E2E flows + Flow Test Mode) rather than `appmixer test component`.
`appmixer e2e import` cannot resolve the account for nested ai/* refs and skips the binding — always pass `-a <accountId>`, otherwise `e2e run` fails its preflight with "No valid account bound".

Search `type` and `category` option lists were checked against the live API, not just the docs: an unknown `type` is rejected with a 400 that enumerates the valid set, while an unknown `category` is silently ignored on /search, so a wrong category value would degrade to unfiltered results rather than erroring.

`score` is only returned by the `neural` search type, which the options list did not offer — it was a dead entry in the picker. FindSearchResults now offers neural and keyword (closing the original review's open question), and the NewSearchResult trigger, which deliberately restricts itself to the cheap types, drops `score` instead.

results.e2eValidate: 0 failures (appmixer e2e validate, 29 validators, 3 flow files)
results.e2eCoverage: 5 of 6 components. NewSearchResult is a polling trigger whose firing condition (a page new to Exa's index for the query) cannot be provoked, so it has no E2E flow — it is covered by Flow Test Mode on the instance plus a deterministic tick()/test() harness (13 checks).
results.negativeControl: A copy of the array/notFound flow with both assertions inverted was imported and run: it reported FAILED with both assertion messages, proving the suite can fail. Flow and its store record were deleted afterwards.
results.triggerVerification: appmixer flow test on the instance emitted one real result (dataSource=real); the local harness proves the first tick saves a baseline and emits nothing, later ticks emit only unseen ids, the known-id window caps at 1000, an empty first poll still initialises, and test() emits exactly one item without writing state.
results.ssrfGuard: lib.resolveApiUrl exercised over 15 inputs: foreign origins, protocol-relative //host, embedded credentials, http downgrade, api.exa.ai.evil.com and javascript: are all rejected; only api.exa.ai resolves.
results.connectorVerify: appmixer connector verify ai/exa: 2 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 3 warn. The warnings are optional fields (author, score, favicon, entities) that Exa omits when the page or search type does not produce them. artifacts/verify.json drives the run and artifacts/samples/ holds sanitised shapes so `--offline` works in CI without credentials.
results.itemSchema: The three dynamic-outPort Find components export ITEM_SCHEMA with a `required` list derived from live sampling, so verify honours per-field optionality instead of treating every declared leaf as mandatory.
